result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one section header displays a raw localization key instead of translated text, and the category chip row appears to have an extra empty chip partially visible at the right edge.

issues.description: The section header above the popular restaurants list shows the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you'), while all other headings are properly translated.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key (or fix the key lookup) so the section displays real copy instead of the raw i18n placeholder.

issues.description: At the right edge of the category filter chip row, an empty gray chip shape is partially visible after 'Healthy', which looks like a rendering artifact or an item with missing label/icon rather than intentional content.
issues.suggestion: Verify the chip data source; if the trailing chip has no label, remove it or ensure its content loads so no blank pill is shown at the edge of the row.
